UOM WEIGHTAGE 10 4001451438 UPKEEP AND MAINTENANCE OF MANDIRA DAM CO 24.000 MON 100.00 % Service text of line item 10 :- UPKEEP AND MAINTENANCE OF MANDIRA DAM COMPLEX AS PER THE FOLLOWING SCOPE- HORTICULTURE:- 1The following areas shall come under the preview of upkeep & maintenance of gardens under this contract. a) Garden Area for maintenance of Tarangini Guest House = 5 Acres b) Garden Area for maintenance of Hill Top Guest House = 5 Acres The area includes lawn, Hedge plants, Rose Plants, wooded area, Rose beds, Ornamental and other decorative plants, seasonal flower beds, features like water fountains etc. As an emergency measure a group of emplo yees to be deployed by the agency to execute the work in a shift. 2Cleaning & Upkeepment: This pertains to general cleanlin ess wherein the entire garden and wooded area has to be kept neat & clean and under presentable condition throughout the contra ct period. This includes keeping the garden/ wooded areas, including cemented area, path ways or structures free from any unw anted plants/grasses, papers, dry leaves, polythenes, mucks, stones or debris etc. Daily. 3Disposal of the Garden wastes: The waste materials like cut grasses, dry leaves dry out plant materials etc. has to be pro perly disposed off and shall required to be dumped in suitable places for decomposition as decided by the executing office r. Daily. 4Wild Growth/Bush Cutting: The entire garden premises including non grassing/wooded area should remain free from any wild growth during the entire contract period. Daily. 5Mowing of grasses: Mowing or cutting of the grass to be carried out regularly or as and when required by keeping the height of the grass approx. not more than 2.5cm above the soil surface throughout the contract period. Daily 6Watering: Providing regular and continuous watering in adequate quantities to plantation and lawn areas including pot pl ants, seasonal flower beds from the water source points given inside garden area by RSP for the proper growth and develo pment of all plants, seasonal plants, lawn grasses etc. throughout the contract period. daily watering of the turf in downstr eam of earthen dam.Necessary hosepipes required for watering, portable sprinklers etc shall be arranged by the agency. Daily. 7Manuring of Plants: Supply and application of manures to all plants, grasses, Rose plants, pot plants, seasonal flower beds in adequate quantity with well rotten cow dung manures or compost /as per the size and requirement of the plants twice in a yea r preferably once before the onset of monsoon and second during winter season. Weekly. 8Application of Fertilizers & Other Nutrients: Supply and application of DAP, MOP, Neem Oil Cake, Bone Meal, Oil Cake, Rally Meal etc twice in a year to all plants, Rose plants, lawn area including potted plants as per the need along with the cow dun g manures as directed by the site in charge. Monthly. 9Termite Control: Supply and application of anti-termite chemicals to control termite infestations. Flooding of Chloropyriphos in the lawn area or plant basin with adequate water is to be done wherever required to control severe termite infestation. Fortnightly.

10Pests Control: Supply and application of insecticides/pesticides for pest control measures during the incidence of pests/ins ects infestation or as and when required by applying suitable pesticides in appropriate proportion. Fortnightly. 11Disease Control: Supply and application of fungicides/ bactericides etc. for diseases control measures during the incidence of disease attack in plants or as and when required by applying suitable fungicides/ bactericides in appropriate proportion. Monthly. 12Weed Control: De-weeding of all unwanted plants throughout the garden area including lawn at regular interval or as an d when required with the help of suitable tools so as to keep the entire area free ofw eeds. Weekly. 13Intercultural operations: Intercultural operations like hoeing and weeding of beds, pot plants, plants etc. to be carried out with the help of suitable tools as and when required for proper aeration by loosening the soil and drying it for few days followed by watering. Weekly. 14Pruning & Trimming: Pruning and trimming of plants to be carried out at regular interval or as when required to keep all plants like shrubs, hedges, Rose plants, ground covers etc. under desired shape and size. Weekly. 15Training: Regular training of plants to be carried out for giving plants and hedges desired shape and structure. Weekly. 16Application of Urea: Supply and application of Urea @ 0.25 gms/sqm in lawn areas as and when required as additional nutrition an d for quick growth and greening of grasses. Monthly. 17Growing of Seasonal Flowering Plants: Growing of seasonal flowering plants of different varieties by maintaining colour harmony i n the earmarked or specified flower beds and in earthen pots inside garden premises for different flowering seasons. Monthly. 18Multiplication of plants: The agency has to propagate different shrubs, plants including fruit bearing & decorative plants etc. with their poly bagging as per the direction of site in-charge as per need & requirement. Monthly. 19Maintenance of Pot Plants: Raising of adequate numbers of pot plants for decoration purposes, their display at site as per require ment & during VIP visits. Maintaining of pot plants require under healthy condition during the entire maintenance period including r e-potting, intercultural operations, manuring, watering and keeping it under clean and aesthetic condition. Required pots will be sup plied by the agency. Daily. 20Plantation Work: Incase of addition of new plantation in the park premises, the agency will be required to carry out plantation work of these plant/shrubs including their supply and it#s after care for proper growth and development as per the direction of s ite in charge. Monthly. 21Stacking of Plants: Proper stacking of all plants to be carried out with bamboo sticks to keep it under erect position wherever necessary. Weekly. 22Material Supply: All materials like manures and fertilizers, pesticides, tools, tackles and implements, machines etc. required f or the garden maintenance including seasonal flower plants has to be supplied by the agency during the entire contract period. 23Replacement of plants on mortality: All dead or damaged plants resulting due to any reason during the contract period shall h ave to be replaced by the agency with same species, height and size during the maintenance contract period. Fortnightly.

24Disposal of garden waste : All organic waste shall be dumped at the specified locations of the garden/park for making co mpost. Non-biodegradable shall be dumped in the garbage bins placed at the specified locations. Daily. 25Minor development: The agency shall be required to carry out minor development work with addition of plants as per requir ement at his own cost as per the direction of executing officer/ site in-charge. Fortnightly. 26Pruning of tree branches: the agency make his own arrangement to go for pruning of the tree branches whenever and whe rever required as per the direction of site in-charge. Weekly. ELECTRI CAL:- 27. Weekly check up of DG sets and trial run shall be done by the agency under supervision of the site-incharge and the ag ency shall take up repair works as and when required after clearance from the site-incharge. Minor consummables like cable, connector, insulating tape etc will be supplied by the agency. Weekly. 29. Inspection and repair of all AC units at the Guest Houses. Major spares will be supplied by RSP. Consumables including gas f or refilling of ACs to be supplied by the agency. Monthly. 30. Minor transformer maintenance, laying of overhead and underground LT cables as per requirement, inspection & maintenance of lights, area lighters, street lights and inside guest houses, control room, colony, barrack, sluice and earthen da ms. Transformer oil, LT cables, light fittings will be supplied by RSP. Minor consumables like wire, fuses, black tape, brackets etc shall be supplied by the agency. Daily. 31. Inspection and maintenance of coils of spillway gates and sluice gates drives. For replacement, coils will be supplied by RSP . W e e kl y. CI VI L: - 32. Sweeping, washing, mopping and dedusting of both the guest houses, kitchens, barrack; cleaning, distaining and deodorising of all toilets, once a day, cleaning of gazebos and other installations as per direction of site-in-charge, supplementing hand wash, soaps and towels, buckets and mugs as and when required. Water jets to be used for cleaning, wherever required. Daily.

33. Jungle cutting, wild growth removing and tree pruning, cutting of dead trees along the entire road from the main gate near Office to the end of earthen dam, colony, both ends of the spillway and sluice dams, main earthen dam body, down stream ston e pitching of earthen dam, sluice channel area including cleaning of berms, disposal of debris at identified place. To be done onc e in every week and as per direction of site in charge. Weekly. 34. Repair of structural gates and fences including painting; fabrication, erection, painting and display of signage boards, wherever required. Structurals and mesh will be supplied by agency. Weekly. 35. Inspection and minor repairs of storage tanks, sumps and associated structures. Monthly. 36. Painting of structurals, light posts, trees inside guest houses upto a height of 2 meters, gazebos, rappelling tower, spillwa y barricade and other installations as per the direction of site incharge. Paint , thinner, brush etc to be supplied by the agency. Monthly. MECHANICAL:- 37. Inspection and repair of both side railings/fences of both spillway and earthen dams, sluice outlet. Inspection and repair of structures leading to operating platform of spillway gates. Weekly. 38. Daily check up and running maintenance of the raw water pumps, Hilltop Guest House pumps, bore well pump ,pipelines and fittings. Minor consumables like nuts, bolts, rubber sheet, grease etc will be supplied by the agency. Major spares will be supplied by RSP. Daily. 39. Inspection and repair of major structural erections like Rapelling Tower, Gazebos etc including painting. All structural will be supplied by RSP. Monthly. 40. Monthly Inspection of spillway gate gear boxes and refilling of oil, as and when required, under supervision of site in charge. Application of cadmium compound on gate ropes as per direction of the site incharge. Oil and cadmium compound will be supplied by RSP. Monthly. MIS CELLANEOUS :- Water and power provision shall be made by RSP wherever feasible. Extension of power, water and provision of generator/welding set at job site shall be in the scope of the agency. All tools, tackles, mowing machine, watering hose, distaining material, odoriser, soaps, hand wash, towels, manure and pesticides, saplings, pots, paints, other consumables etc are to be supplied by the agency.
